notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only Timmonstown-specific text found is the FFLA row (gone, coordinates) and the Forest Lookouts page header (Worcester County); the Forest Lookouts page has no narrative text beyond that header. The Timmonstown name appears in other pages only as navigation links. Two web searches turned up nothing more. The story's middle paragraph is statewide context from the DNR history page, not a claim about this tower; the story is about 90 words, under the 120-word floor, because the evidence is that thin. Leads: Barbara Garner, A View from the Top, Maryland's Fire Towers (Abecedarian Books, 2012); Worcester County Historical Society (historicalworcester.org); Maryland DNR forestry tower documents (the 2007 resource document does not list Timmonstown).
